issues.warnBar: {n} profile issue(s) detected · resolve them before saving
issues.cardTitle: Issues are checked automatically on save
issues.cardBody: Click “Save changes” in the top right: the app backs up your profile first, then scans for issues; if any are found, a dialog asks how to handle them, and the file is written only after all issues are resolved. Global settings offer auto-fix / auto-ignore to skip the dialog. The “Issues” panel on the home dashboard always shows the current count.
